name: TX-11
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Pfluger running with large financial advantage
Challenger underfunded with no outside support
model.rationale: Pfluger holds a deep-red seat, has raised over $3 million against a challenger with under $100,000, and prediction markets give him roughly a 96% chance of winning. No polls or expert ratings suggest any competitive threat, so the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A late surge in outside spending for Reynolds or a major scandal involving Pfluger would be the only realistic path to competitiveness.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
TX-11 is a heavily Republican West Texas district where August Pfluger is seeking another term. The partisan lean of about R+17, combined with his incumbency, makes the seat very difficult for any Democrat to carry. Pfluger has raised roughly $3.2 million and holds $2.9 million in cash, while Democrat Claire Reynolds has raised under $90,000 with no outside spending on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price a Republican win at about 96 percent. The forecast expects Pfluger to win comfortably, with the Democratic challenger needing an extraordinary shift in the environment or resources to make this competitive.
